title: Kota shopkeeper evicted in one month — appeal and same-day stay before the Appellate Rent Tribunal

input.text: Sir, Rent Tribunal Kota ne humein ek mahine mein nikaal diya. Shop in Ghantaghar area, kiraya 18 saal se de rahe hain, receipts hain 2019 tak, uske baad UPI. Landlord bola arrears hain aur uske bete ko showroom chahiye. Order last week aaya, certified copy kal mili. Appeal kitne din mein, stay kaise, kya rent deposit karna padega? Main beginner hoon. BNS/BNSS se yeh Act change hua kya? Client dar raha hai lock nikal denge next week.

triage.oneLineRead: A state Rent Control appeal with a live execution risk; the 2001 Act is untouched by the 2023 codes, and stay practice is local.

issueMap.issue: Limitation for appeal to the Appellate Rent Tribunal
issueMap.note: Read Rajasthan Rent Control Act 2001 s. 19 / s. 9 cluster from a current bare Act. Do not guess the number of days.
Same-day stay usually needs a deposit offer. The amount is not invented.
It is evidence of payment, not automatically 'no arrears'.
Trial finding; appeal is not a second trial unless perversity is pleaded.

COVER NOTE (beginner) — Kota rent appeal

1. Yeh Rajasthan Rent Control Act 2001 ka matter hai — ek STATE Act. BNS/BNSS (2023 codes) ne ise chhua nahi. Appeal memo me BNSS quote karna beginner ki galti hai.
2. Sahi forum: Appellate Rent Tribunal, Kota — District Court me civil first appeal NAHI.
3. Limitation: Rent Control Act ka appeal provision (confirm s. 19 / allied) — [PENDING — 30 din maan lena galat hai; bare Act se confirm karo]. Certified copy kal mili, isliye jaldi.
4. Same-day stay: deposit offer ke saath. Stay pending appeal [PENDING — COURT_SAFE authority chahiye].
5. Grounds: Rajasthan Rent Control Act 2001, s. 9 (arrears, bete ki bonafide need). Perversity plead karo, dobara trial nahi.
6. Checklist: certified order + copy endorsement, complete UPI export (UTR), koi written lease / shop licence, admitted rent vs arrears calculation, vakalatnama for Appellate Tribunal.

Client ko samjhao: appeal jaldi, stay deposit ke saath — lock change hone se pehle.

checklist: Any written lease or shop licence
Calculation of admitted rent vs claimed arrears

terminalOutcome.label: File the appeal urgently with a stay and a deposit offer — after reading the limitation section
terminalOutcome.rationale: Execution next week is the real emergency. The codes of 2023 do not rewrite this Act.
terminalOutcome.nextAction: Confirm appeal limitation from the bare Act, prepare stay + deposit, do not attack 'son's need' as if facts can be re-tried without a perversity ground.

teachingNotes: Rent Control in Rajasthan is a state statute. Quoting BNSS in the appeal memo is a beginner tell.
Stay without a deposit offer is how locks get changed while you 'research'.
UPI is a chronology, not a legal argument, until it is matched to the claimed arrears.
commonMistakes: Filing a civil first appeal in the District Court instead of the Appellate Rent Tribunal.
Inventing a 30-day limitation because 'most appeals are 30 days'.
Writing that 18 years of possession creates ownership.
seniorVariants: Lead the stay application with readiness to deposit the decreed amount / admitted rent.
Plead perversity on arrears if the Tribunal ignored UPI; do not merely re-argue equities.
Check whether a written statement was even filed below — mid-journey defects travel.

accuracy.adverseFact: If the UPI is to a personal number not named in the order as the landlord's account, the 'we paid' story may be treated as unproved and the default finding will stand.
